difference: Old D stopped one unfolding and inherited a crease as a hole base; old C substituted crease directions for cut directions. The new first B attempt compared one cut slope with two border Vs. This refinement introduces a different two-channel endpoint/crease relation and four border notches: bottom-crease endpoint -> top/bottom pair, right-crease endpoint -> left/right pair. It is not a palette swap or B-to-A substitution of the same four slants; it changes both the source feature partition and receiver orbit structure. Preset A is derived from this endpoint-as-independent-notch hypothesis, not from the previous C/E outputs.
